verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents toggling flags per environment, unlimited environments, environment management via its API, and SDK authentication through a per-environment Environment Key. RBAC can restrict who changes production, and release pipelines promote flags between environments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dev/staging/prod environment setup, detail on separate server-side versus client-side key scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage separate environments (dev/staging/prod) with independent flag states and scoped SDK keys

citations.quote: use Flagsmith to toggle that feature on or off for different environments, users, or user segments.
Authentication: Uses a public, non-secret Environment Key.
Creating, updating, and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments, and users.
Only allow certain users to modify your production environments.
Release Pipelines can automatically generate change requests when promoting flags to production
